en: Multi‑view color postcard with a collage of landmarks from the town of Breaza. Views include a war memorial with an eagle on top set in a park, a building signed "ARTA CASNICĂ," a large villa with a red roof, and a culture house with arched loggia, all surrounded by gardens. The center panel has the title "BREAZA." The reverse is written in Romanian with a Romanian stamp and postmarks.
